lines: Warm water seeps up through the sand. It tastes of copper and old promises.

sign: Once the greenest place in Solenne. Now under new management.

lines: A bronze sluice wheel. A brass plate on it reads: PROPERTY OF THE BRASS VEIL.
A bronze sluice wheel. A brass plate on it reads: PROPERTY OF THE BRASS VEIL.
A bronze sluice wheel. A brass plate on it reads: PROPERTY OF THE BRASS VEIL.

hint: Carved by the old well-diggers: Below, open one, never two, or the low gate drowns. Above, the high gate wants two.
noor: Noor: Kaia says the water left on its own. Water doesn't sign receipts, though.
noor_intro: Noor: You want Kaia? She's busy being adored. Duel first.
noor_defeat: Noor: Fine. Ask her where the water went. Watch her smile.
hollis: Hollis: I count every drop that leaves the oasis. Lately I count the people who ask about it.
hollis_intro: Hollis: Your name isn't on my list. Let's fix that.
hollis_defeat: Hollis: Struck off. In ink, sadly.
suni: Suni: The palms are thirsty. So am I. Only one of us gets paid for it.
suni_intro: Suni: I pick dates. Today I'm picking a fight.
suni_defeat: Suni: Bitter harvest. Go on, Kaia's waiting. She's always waiting for someone.

lines: Kaia: Welcome to the oasis! Mind the cracks. They used to be the lake.
Kaia: The water's back. The Veil will want it back too. I'd leave town before they send their regards.
Kaia: Here, Dawn Mend. A healing art, from me. Yes, I see the irony. I charge extra for it.
Kaia: The Veil fired me. Then the town hired me back. Turns out they needed someone who knows how thieves think.

kaia_intro: Kaia: The Rift drank the water. Terrible. Tragic. Nothing anyone could have done, least of all me.
Kaia: Still, a Warden must guard her Rift. Even from people who ask too many questions.
kaia_defeat: Kaia: ...Oh, fine. You'd find the contract anyway. Everyone does, eventually.
Kaia: I sold the water rights to the Brass Veil. The Rift opened the night they started pumping. Bad timing. Good price.
Kaia: I've worked for the Veil for six years. Ochrewell paid me in thanks. The Veil paid me in gold. Guess which buys bread.
Kaia: Mend it, then. The contract has a clause for acts of heroism. You'll find it tedious.
